#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class GTakeMetro {
public:
    void solve() {
        int n, m;
        long long t;
        cin >> n >> m;
        int s;
        cin >> s;
        s -= 1;
        cin >> t;

        while (t % n != 0) {
            if (s < m) {
                s = (int)((s + t) % n);
            } else {
                s = (int)((s - t) % n);
                if (s < 0) s += n;
            }
            t--;
        }
        t /= n;

        vector<int> seen(n, -1);
        seen[s] = 0;
        int count = 0;

        while (t-- > 0) {
            count++;
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
                if (s < m) {
                    s = (s + i) % n;
                } else {
                    s = (s - i + n) % n;
                }
            }
            if (seen[s] != -1) {
                t %= (count - seen[s]);
            }
            seen[s] = count;
        }
        cout << s + 1 << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    GTakeMetro solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
